sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Carter P. Call.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Call worked for the American Fork Police Department from March 15, 2021 to October 19, 2023.

After leaving the American Fork Police Department, Call appeared in 2023 Utah County payroll records as a Deputy Sheriff II assigned to enforcement. The records reviewed do not establish whether he remains employed by the Utah County Sheriff’s Office.
